How Ordinary Clay Becomes Art in the Hands of Master Potters. Korean Pottery

Hello, this is King Process.
In this video, we bring together the top three Korean pottery-making processes, showing how ordinary clay becomes a work of art in the hands of skilled artisans.
You will see a unique mug that looks like knitted fabric but is actually made from clay, a master potter who has been shaping ceramics for half a century, and the process of creating a large traditional Korean jar with clay and fire.
From kneading the clay and shaping each piece to long periods of drying, kiln firing, glazing, and final finishing, every piece of pottery requires a great deal of time, patience, and care.
Watch how Korean pottery artisans work with clay in different ways, transforming ordinary earth into practical vessels and beautiful works of art.
We hope you enjoy the video.
Thank you for watching. If you enjoyed it, please subscribe and give the video a like!
